title: Slay the Spire
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. Reported by DerReparator (highball-db#601, 2026-10-21), Apple M2 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT environment, msync, rated 4 of 5 after 3 minutes.
notes: Works, by community consensus. A report on an M2 Pro with the default engine and DXMT has very infrequent, very short stutters, only in Fullscreen and Borderless Fullscreen on a 14-inch MacBook Pro, and an 8BitDo wireless controller that works here while it does not in the game's native Mac version. The native Mac version is the simpler way to play otherwise.

knownIssues.symptom: Very infrequent, very short stutters in Fullscreen and Borderless Fullscreen (reported on an M2 Pro 14-inch MacBook Pro, DXMT, engine r28)
